from collections import deque

def get_group_and_liberties(board, r, c):
    color = board[r, c]
    if color == 0:
        return set(), set()
    group = set()
    liberties = set()
    q = deque([(r, c)])
    visited = set([(r, c)])
    while q:
        cr, cc = q.popleft()
        group.add((cr, cc))
        for dr, dc in [(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)]:
            nr, nc = cr+dr, cc+dc
            if 0 <= nr < 19 and 0 <= nc < 19:
                if board[nr, nc] == 0:
                    liberties.add((nr, nc))
                elif board[nr, nc] == color and (nr, nc) not in visited:
                    visited.add((nr, nc))
                    q.append((nr, nc))
    return group, liberties

def is_legal(board, r, c, player):
    if board[r, c] != 0:
        return False
    temp = board.copy()
    temp[r, c] = player
    # capture opponent groups
    for dr, dc in [(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)]:
        nr, nc = r+dr, c+dc
        if 0 <= nr < 19 and 0 <= nc < 19 and temp[nr, nc] == -player:

    # check own group liberties
    group, liberties = get_group_and_liberties(temp, r, c)
    if len(liberties) == 0:
        return False
    return True

def apply_move(board, r, c, player):

import numpy as np
from collections import deque

def get_group_and_liberties(board, r, c):
    color = board[r, c]
    if color == 0:
        return [], set()
    group = []
    liberties = set()
    visited = np.zeros((19,19), dtype=bool)
    q = deque([(r, c)])
    visited[r, c] = True
    while q:
        cr, cc = q.popleft()
        group.append((cr, cc))
        for dr, dc in [(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)]:
            nr, nc = cr+dr, cc+dc
            if 0 <= nr < 19 and 0 <= nc < 19:
                if board[nr, nc] == 0:
                    liberties.add((nr, nc))
                elif board[nr, nc] == color and not visited[nr, nc]:
                    visited[nr, nc] = True
                    q.append((nr, nc))
    return group, liberties

def is_legal(board, r, c, player):
    if board[r, c] != 0:
        return False
    temp = board.copy()
    temp[r, c] = player
    # capture opponent
    for dr, dc in [(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)]:
        nr, nc = r+dr, c+dc
        if 0 <= nr < 19 and 0 <= nc < 19 and temp[nr, nc] == -player:
            group, liberties = get_group_and_liberties(temp, nr, nc)
            if len(liberties) == 0:
                for (gr, gc) in group:
                    temp[gr, gc] = 0
    # check own
    group, liberties = get_group_and_liberties(temp, r, c)
    return len(liberties) > 0

def apply_move(board, r, c, player):
    board[r, c] = player
    for dr, dc in [(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)]:
        nr, nc = r+dr, c+dc
        if 0 <= nr < 19 and 0 <= nc < 19 and board[nr, nc] == -player:
            group, liberties = get_group_and_liberties(board, nr, nc)
            if len(liberties) == 0:
                for (gr, gc) in group:
                    board[gr, gc] = 0

def evaluate_board(board, player):
    dist_me = np.full((19,19), 999, dtype=np.int16)
    dist_opp = np.full((19,19), 999, dtype=np.int16)
    q_me = deque()
    q_opp = deque()
    for r in range(19):
        for c in range(19):
            if board[r,c] == player:
                dist_me[r,c] = 0
                q_me.append((r,c))
            elif board[r,c] == -player:
                dist_opp[r,c] = 0
                q_opp.append((r,c))
    # BFS me
    while q_me:
        r,c = q_me.popleft()
        d = dist_me[r,c] + 1
        for dr,dc in [(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)]:
            nr, nc = r+dr, c+dc
            if 0 <= nr < 19 and 0 <= nc < 19 and board[nr,nc] == 0 and dist_me[nr,nc] > d:
                dist_me[nr,nc] = d
                q_me.append((nr,nc))
    # BFS opp
    while q_opp:
        r,c = q_opp.popleft()
        d = dist_opp[r,c] + 1
        for dr,dc in [(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)]:
            nr, nc = r+dr, c+dc
            if 0 <= nr < 19 and 0 <= nc < 19 and board[nr,nc] == 0 and dist_opp[nr,nc] > d:
                dist_opp[nr,nc] = d
                q_opp.append((nr,nc))
    my_score = np.count_nonzero(board == player)
    opp_score = np.count_nonzero(board == -player)
    for r in range(19):
        for c in range(19):
            if board[r,c] == 0:
                if dist_me[r,c] < dist_opp[r,c]:
                    my_score += 1
                elif dist_opp[r,c] < dist_me[r,c]:
                    opp_score += 1
    return my_score - opp_score

def generate_candidates(board, player):
    candidates = set()
    stones_positions = np.argwhere(board != 0)
    total_stones = len(stones_positions)
    # Adjacent moves
    for r,c in stones_positions:
        for dr,dc in [(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)]:
            nr, nc = r+dr, c+dc
            if 0 <= nr < 19 and 0 <= nc < 19 and board[nr,nc] == 0:
                candidates.add((nr,nc))
    # If few stones, add strategic opening points
    if total_stones < 10:
        star_points = [(3,3), (3,9), (3,15), (9,3), (9,9), (9,15), (15,3), (15,9), (15,15)]  # 0-indexed 4-4 etc
        for p in star_points:
            if board[p[0], p[1]] == 0:
                candidates.add(p)
    # If no candidates (should not happen unless board full), add center if empty
    if not candidates:
        for r in range(19):
            for c in range(19):
                if board[r,c] == 0:
                    candidates.add((r,c))
                    break
            if candidates: break
    # Filter legal moves
    legal = []
    for r,c in candidates:
        if is_legal(board, r, c, player):
            legal.append((r,c))
    # Pass is always an option
    legal.append((0,0))  # pass represented as (0,0)
    return legal

def policy(me, opponent):
    board = np.zeros((19,19), dtype=np.int8)
    for r,c in me:
        board[r-1, c-1] = 1
    for r,c in opponent:
        board[r-1, c-1] = -1
    
    my_candidates = generate_candidates(board, 1)
    best_score = -9999
    best_move = (0,0)
    
    for move in my_candidates:
        if move == (0,0):
            board_after_me = board.copy()
        else:
            board_after_me = board.copy()
            apply_move(board_after_me, move[0], move[1], 1)
        
        opp_candidates = generate_candidates(board_after_me, -1)
        if not opp_candidates:
            score = evaluate_board(board_after_me, 1)
        else:
            min_score = 9999
            for opp_move in opp_candidates:
                if opp_move == (0,0):
                    board_after_opp = board_after_me.copy()
                else:
                    board_after_opp = board_after_me.copy()
                    apply_move(board_after_opp, opp_move[0], opp_move[1], -1)
                score = evaluate_board(board_after_opp, 1)
                if score < min_score:
                    min_score = score
            score = min_score
        if score > best_score:
            best_score = score
            best_move = move
    
    if best_move == (0,0):
        return (0,0)
    else:
        return (best_move[0]+1, best_move[1]+1)

```python
def evaluate_board(board, player):
    dist = np.full((19,19), 999, dtype=np.int16)
    color_mask = np.zeros((19,19), dtype=np.int8)  # 1 for player, -1 for opponent, 0 for neutral
    q = deque()
    for r in range(19):
        for c in range(19):
            if board[r,c] == player:
                dist[r,c] = 0
                color_mask[r,c] = 1
                q.append((r,c,1))
            elif board[r,c] == -player:
                dist[r,c] = 0
                color_mask[r,c] = -1
                q.append((r,c,-1))
    while q:
        r, c, col = q.popleft()
        d = dist[r,c] + 1
        for dr, dc in [(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)]:
            nr, nc = r+dr, c+dc
            if 0 <= nr < 19 and 0 <= nc < 19:
                if board[nr,nc] == 0:
                    if dist[nr,nc] > d:
                        dist[nr,nc] = d
                        color_mask[nr,nc] = col
                        q.append((nr,nc,col))
                    elif dist[nr,nc] == d and color_mask[nr,nc] != col:
                        color_mask[nr,nc] = 0  # neutral
    # Count
    my_score = np.count_nonzero(color_mask == 1)
    opp_score = np.count_nonzero(color_mask == -1)
    return my_score - opp_score
```
